questions.Q1: How well does the service judge under the production condition (A0-T) agree with human-reviewed reference labels: misses, false alarms, abstentions?
questions.Q2: Of the A0-T errors, how many are explained by missing context (A4-T Oracle correct) and how many remain with full context (A4-T also wrong)?
questions.auxiliary: T0 versus A0-T shows what the A0 context adds

frozenBefore: reading any transcript text of a J1 video, labelling, human review or running the service judge; results never feed back into these rules

data.videos: 3 new long Korean multi-speaker videos from channels not used in P0, P1, the Far challenge set, R2-A or R2-B, chosen at video level before reading transcripts; same Groq STT path (tools/service_stt_transcript.py); transcripts frozen

RISK_NOMINATED.tool: tools/far_nominations.py --role RISK_NOMINATOR, gpt-6-luna, reasoning_effort high, JSON mode
RISK_NOMINATED.budget: at most 20 per video, one call per video, no reruns; the nominator sees the frozen transcript only

RANDOM.rule: j1-random-v1 in tools/j1_targets.py: segments with at least 2 Hangul, Latin or digit characters, in transcript order, split into 20 contiguous blocks (block i = floor(i*n/20) .. floor((i+1)*n/20)-1), one pick per block with random.Random(int(sha256(transcriptFileSha256 + ':j1-random-v1')[:16], 16)).randrange
RANDOM.overlap: a random pick that is also nominated stays in RISK_NOMINATED and is dropped from RANDOM without refill; the overlap count is reported

data.stopRule: evaluate exactly this budget (at most 120 cases); report the counts that occur; never relax the rules to reach a target count; never redraw, swap or drop a target

referenceLabels.aiDraft: tools/ai_labels.py with T1 v2 (SHA-256 542d826fd9814a24caef67d09721eb4d49cc7cb689baca6bc546e655f4346da1), Topic and T2; labellers never see layers, nomination reasons or the study purpose
referenceLabels.humanReviewScope: j1-review-sample-v1 in tools/j1_targets.py: every case whose AI T2 is REVIEW_REQUIRED or UNCERTAIN, every invalid AI label, every RISK_NOMINATED case, and per video 10 RANDOM cases with AI PASS drawn by random.Random(int(sha256(transcriptFileSha256 + ':j1-review-sample-v1')[:16], 16)).sample over those cases in transcript order
referenceLabels.blindStep: the reviewer sees the review sheet (target, transcript window of 120 s either side, full transcript on request) and never the AI decision, AI context, layer or nomination reason; records humanDecision PASS | REVIEW_REQUIRED | UNCERTAIN, contextSegmentIds and evidenceSegmentIds
referenceLabels.adjudication: where the blind human decision differs from the AI T2 decision, the reviewer then reads the AI rationale and sets the final label with a written reason; blind human label, AI draft and final label are all kept
referenceLabels.notReviewed: RANDOM cases with AI PASS outside the review sample keep the AI label, are marked AI_ONLY_PASS and are reported apart from the primary metrics
referenceLabels.freeze: final labels are frozen before the service judge runs and are never changed after seeing its output

conditions.T0: target only: empty context (new TARGET_ONLY selector, to be added to ContextExperimentTrial before the run); named T0 to avoid the P0 meaning of C0
conditions.A4_T: final-label context plus evidence minus target (OracleContextSelector); diagnostic, not a production condition
conditions.runner: ContextExperimentRunner with runExperimental; visual stage, router and casebook null
conditions.costCheck: measure the cost on the first 5 cases of video 5001 under all three conditions; if the projected total exceeds the cap, stop and ask before continuing

metrics.binary: final REVIEW_REQUIRED -> RISK, PASS -> NO_RISK; final UNCERTAIN cases are left out of the primary metrics and counted
metrics.serverMapping: REVIEW_REQUIRED -> RISK; PASS and NO_CANDIDATE -> NO_RISK; UNCERTAIN -> ABSTAIN; NOT_RETURNED, CALL_FAILED, REJECTED, CONFLICT, NOT_SELECTED -> NOT_EVALUATED; ABSTAIN and NOT_EVALUATED count as wrong
metrics.perCondition: miss rate (RISK judged NO_RISK), false-alarm rate (NO_RISK judged RISK), abstain rate, not-evaluated rate, coverage, selective accuracy; per-case accuracy over repeats first; video-cluster percentile bootstrap 95% CI with a fixed seed; paired condition differences on the same resamples
metrics.layers: RISK_NOMINATED and RANDOM always reported apart; any pooled figure is labelled a risk-oversampled sample, not a production average
metrics.errorBreakdown: each A0-T error case (majority of repeats wrong) is MISSING_CONTEXT when A4-T is right on the majority of repeats, otherwise JUDGMENT_ERROR

judgmentErrorCategories.RISK_INTERPRETATION: the model read the meaning or intent of the utterance differently from the final label (joke, quotation, irony, target of the remark)
judgmentErrorCategories.GUIDELINE_BOUNDARY: the model and the final label agree on the meaning but place it on different sides of the review threshold
judgmentErrorCategories.STT_QUALITY: a transcription error changes the meaning the model judged
judgmentErrorCategories.OTHER: none of the above; the reason is written down

metrics.categoryAssignment: the human reviewer assigns one category per JUDGMENT_ERROR case after the run, reading the model output; categories are descriptive and never change labels or metrics
metrics.emptyDenominators: N/A with counts; percentages always with counts
metrics.humanAiAgreement: blind human decision versus AI T2 decision on the reviewed cases, reported with counts
